answer_1.quote: In this work, we explore the use of large language models to generate guiding sub-questions for math word problems.
answer_1.outputs: Socratic questions for math word problems

answer_4.quote: Next, we perform a human evaluation of the questions generated for 100 randomly selected test MWPs to assess the quality of our model generation (our best model) compared to the baseline (with no planning or reward-based strategies).
answer_4.guideline: A 5-point Likert scale ranging from 1 (poor) to 5 (very good) was used for each dimensions of quality assessment
